threads.body:
[Testing] This rewritten overview omits messaging even though `SemconvSelectionResolver.messaging()` also uses `otel.semconv-stability.preview`. Include messaging here so contributors know its assertions still require preview-mode coverage.

This issue also appears on line 30 of the same file.
threads.hunk:
@@ -1,77 +1,90 @@
 # [Semconv] Dual Semconv Testing
 
-Use this article when changing semconv opt-in tests or their Gradle tasks.
+Use this article when changing semconv selection tests or their Gradle tasks.
 It shows which modes each domain requires and how to express their
 expected attributes without hiding mode differences.
 
-## Background: The Three Modes
+## Selectable domains
 
-The system property `otel.semconv-stability.opt-in` (or env `OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN`)
-controls which attributes are emitted at runtime. Tests must run in all applicable modes.
+Use `otel.semconv-stability.opt-in` or `OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN` for stable code
+conventions. Use `otel.semconv-stability.preview` or `OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_PREVIEW`
+for RPC and service-peer preview conventions. Tests must run in all applicable modes.

threads.body: [Testing] `/dup` coverage is also required for selectable messaging conventions; existing messaging modules wire `preview=messaging/dup` (for example, `instrumentation/kafka/kafka-clients/kafka-clients-2.6/library/build.gradle.kts:44-48`). Limiting this requirement to RPC would incorrectly direct contributors to drop that coverage.

-| -------------- | :---------------: | :------------------: | ------------------------------------------------- |

+Select code conventions separately with `otel.semconv-stability.opt-in=code`.

+preview values outside v3-preview. V3-preview ignores those legacy tokens for preview domains.

-| Code         | `code` / `code/dup`                 | `emitOldCodeSemconv()`, `emitStableCodeSemconv()`               |
-| RPC          | `rpc` / `rpc/dup`                   | `emitOldRpcSemconv()`, `emitStableRpcSemconv()`                 |
-| Service peer | `service.peer` / `service.peer/dup` | `emitOldServicePeerSemconv()`, `emitStableServicePeerSemconv()` |

threads.body: [Testing] This rule incorrectly limits preview and `/dup` coverage to RPC/service-peer. Messaging also uses `otel.semconv-stability.preview`, and existing modules wire `preview=messaging/dup` (for example, `instrumentation/kafka/kafka-clients/kafka-clients-2.6/library/build.gradle.kts:37-48`). Omitting it would direct reviewers to skip required messaging dual-mode tasks.
